summary: Bound cancellation escalation through the uniform J retirement path (unit 9b)

rules.detail: INACTIVE timed stop requires an explicit escalation duration, with no default. Kill, positive populated=0 confirmation, sample and removal use the same retirement internals as launch and recovery.

compatibility.detail: Existing unbounded launch/recovery retirement API is retained; cancellation adds typed kill, population, timeout and removal errors.

manual.detail: Fake-tree tests cover never-empty, failed removal, vanished J, missing control files and kill failure. Cargo and native execution not run.

recovery.detail: Only confirmed absence of J is a vanished-tree success with counters-unavailable. Other failures cannot acknowledge cancellation.
